messages:
terry: quick thread on handoff atomicity tradeoff we hit in the unified kv path. short version: we removed a sync point and saw ~200-400ms stale-read window on cross-node handoffs for long-lived cursors

anne: confirmed. repro in canary shows read-after-evict seeing demoted items until lease-epoch propagated. not data-loss but breaks streaming correctness SLOs.

miguel: what are options?

terry: options we sketched:
- keep async: best perf, small correctness window
- reintroduce forced lease-refresh on handoff: removes window, adds an RPC (~+1ms p99 on handoff-heavy traces)
- targeted strong-reads for active cursors only
- make forced-refresh opt-in per deployment class

sam: recommend opt-in flag + telemetry. Hosted default stays async; Dedicated/Private default to strict. add a metric prefetch.handoff_inconsistent_reads and tracing around handoff+read.

miguel: agree. I'll add chaos test (kill owner mid-handoff) and a unit test for lease-epoch fencing.

terry: plan:
1) implement feature flag kv.unified.strict_handoff (default OFF) that re-enables lease-refresh when ON
2) add metric + tracing and a repro job run in canary
3) run 72h canary with flag ON for small % traffic + chaos
4) if stable, enable by default for Dedicated/Private, keep Hosted default OFF for two releases then revisit

opsbot: Ticket created RDW-ENG-9921: "canary: kv strict_handoff deploy + repro". Assignees: terry, miguel, sam. Canary window: 72h.

anne: I'll attach perf delta (+~0.8ms p99 in our microbench) to the ticket and draft SE notes.

terry: thanks all. will post canary results here and close the loop.
